summary: Static technical audit against the expanded file (scripts/expand-md.js — output byte-identical to source: this file has zero {{prompt:}} markers and zero fenced **Prompt** blocks) plus four compendiums (platform_and_boundaries, research_claims, prompts, pedagogy technical subset). This is a ~3-minute AE101 M1 opener lecture (confirmed as the first inbound link in curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md) — pure prose framing, no exercise, no student-copied prompt, no skill reference, no URL, no Claude-Code-specific capability claim. The one citable element is a Seth-Godin paraphrase, which is explicitly named as a worked example in check_research_claims.md §1's cultural-vocab carve-out list ('Seth Godin on tools and taste') — correctly closed in the maintainer block as `[cultural-vocab]` with no URL, matching the rule's own example verbatim. 'Session' vocabulary (three uses: 'fits the session', 'the session bends', 'input to the session') is used correctly per §7's unit-of-work convention, with no 'open Claude Code' misphrasing. The Quality line's two pinned SHAs (writing/technical@3605eee, slides@47f3357) were independently re-verified via `git merge-base --is-ancestor` as real ancestor commits of current HEAD (66c9863) -- format matches tooling output, not hand-typed (§24a). The maintainer-block Minor-fix note demoting the 'amplification' claim to a hedge ('So the bet goes') on Brynjolfsson-et-al. grounds was cross-checked against its cited authority (theory-audit.md line 486, itself anchored to Brynjolfsson/Li/Raymond NBER WP 31161) and found consistent -- the demotion is real, not asserted as settled fact in body prose, so no fresh citation debt is created in this file. Because the file makes no prompt-mechanical, platform-capability, or fresh-citation claims, nearly the entire rule ledger below resolves N/A by genuine structural inapplicability (lecture-vs-exercise, no-fence, no-URL), not by omission -- each N/A carries its own one-line reason per the completeness contract. This replaces a prior instance at this path that carried only ~10 hand-picked rows (a silent-skip shape the completeness contract flags) with a full one-entry-per-compendium-rule ledger. No blocking findings. No non-blocking findings requiring maintainer action either -- the file's own maintainer block already self-flags the one open item ('predates the slide rework; re-audit before ship'), which is a Quality-state-tag concern for the orchestrator's separate check, not a technical-class defect in current content.
